description: Estaciones de recarga eléctrica de vehículos en Extremadura is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Junta de Extremadura. Estaciones de recarga eléctrica de vehículos (electrolineras) en Extremadura. Coordenadas en notación UTM ETRS89 (Sistema de Referencia Terrestre Europeo 1989). Coverage: Junta de Extremadura. The publisher named on the listing is Junta de Extremadura. The listing shows 2024-02-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
